title: Multiple Zeta Values in Positive Characteristic: A Kaneko-Zagier-Type Conjecture
summary: In this paper, we study a comparison between $\infty$-adic and finite multiple zeta values in positive characteristic. We construct a surjective comparison map from the algebra of $\infty$-adic multiple zeta values to a quotient of the algebra of finite multiple zeta values. This map factors through the quotient by $ζ_A(q-1)$, thereby establishing the well-definedness of a Kaneko-Zagier-type conjectural map.
